fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/PDP/NewTruckInternalSpecMileage.cy.js#PDP - NewTruckInternalPages [yodhaMileage] [ta] — Tata Yodha 2.0 Mileage TC-PDPI-02: சலுகைகளை சரிபார்க்கவும் lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tata Yodha 2.0 Mileage
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PDPI-02
**Title:** சலுகைகளை சரிபார்க்கவும் lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tata Yodha 2.0 Mileage
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
Open Tata Yodha 2.0 Mileage, click “சலுகைகளை சரிபார்க்கவும்”, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real required-field validation messages for name, mobile and location are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open Tata Yodha 2.0 Mileage
2. Click சலுகைகளை சரிபார்க்கவும்
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify the three required-field messages
